task: BoolParameter instances ignore a globally configured parsing mode because construction always forces implicit parsing. Make an omitted per-instance parsing option inherit the class-level mode, while an explicit option still overrides it and the normal default remains implicit.

commands:
import luigi; B=luigi.BoolParameter; old=B.parsing;
try:
 B.parsing=B.EXPLICIT_PARSING; assert B().parsing == B.EXPLICIT_PARSING; assert B(parsing=B.IMPLICIT_PARSING).parsing == B.IMPLICIT_PARSING
finally: B.parsing=old
assert B().parsing == B.IMPLICIT_PARSING
for mode in (B.IMPLICIT_PARSING,B.EXPLICIT_PARSING):
 B.parsing=mode
 try:
  class Child(B): pass
  assert Child().parsing == mode
  assert B(parsing=B.EXPLICIT_PARSING).parsing == B.EXPLICIT_PARSING
  assert B(default=True)._default is True
  assert B(default=False)._default is False
 finally: B.parsing=old
assert B().parse('true') is True; assert B().parse('false') is False
